### 4. Dangerous Precedents
Historically, applying collective guilt to any group—whether based on religion, race, or nationality—has been used to justify discrimination, prejudice, and violence against innocent people. For this reason, international human rights frameworks, such as the Geneva Conventions, explicitly prohibit collective punishment.

***
